ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; the visible fluke surface is approximately 85% low-intensity (black) and 15% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation across both lobes. A distinct region of high-intensity white mottling is localized on the mid-to-outer left lobe. Several discrete, high-intensity white circular clusters are distributed across the central and right-central areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped central notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge shows low-amplitude, low-frequency irregularities along the main span, transitioning to high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of at least seven discrete, high-intensity circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) mapped across the central and right-central dark fluke regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) predominantly oriented vertically on the right lobe, with smaller disruptions visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake marks on both lobes; jagged and irregular tissue margins at the extreme distal tips indicating physical trauma or colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, high-contrast textured protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
